title: Nowhere-zero $3$-flows in graphs with forbidden edge-cuts
summary: Tutte's $3$-flow conjecture asserts that every $4$-edge-connected graph admits a nowhere-zero $3$-flow. In 2013, Lovász, Thomassen, Wu, and Zhang proved that every odd-$7$-edge-connected graph admits a nowhere-zero $3$-flow; consequently, the conjecture holds for $4$-edge-connected graphs with no edge-cut of size $5$. We consider the complementary situation in which $5$-edge-cuts are allowed. We show that, when edge-cuts of size $5$ are permitted, Tutte's $3$-flow conjecture holds for graphs with no edge-cut of any size from $6$ to $k$, where $k$ is an absolute constant. In fact, $k=40$…
